scope: Preparation using existing inputs, captured responses and source inspection; no new backend or semantic extension
comparison: Compare decisions and invariants; mock scores, CVEs, IDs and statuses are not numeric oracles for the native backend

cti_reference.scope_note: Historical captured responses, not current service availability or complete software safety

cases.name: vulnerable

real_target.selection: first effectiveStatus=accepted in returned native ranking; no fixed strategy ID
real_target.shared_finalization: completed with readback for each assessed CVE

cases.source_readiness: positive CTI capture and mock input available; coherent vulnerable build/SBOM/SDK export still to materialize
remaining_preparation: Reuse examples/observed-app in an isolated directory with the selected dependency version; preserve the current POM and archived sources
Verify actual loaded JAR, SBOM and OTel with existing inspect_sources
Bind all actual candidate/CVE pairs to existing KG and validation individuals; do not reuse illustrative example bindings without checking
Confirm actual capabilities as operator policy, not observed OTel facts

cases.name: non_vulnerable_in_snapshot
cases.change_from_baseline: dependency version; software identity and workload retained for the eventual paired builds
cases.mockup_limitation: The existing exact-match mock cannot establish a negative assessment; no backend extension is planned

real_target.outcome: no_findings only with resolved identity and complete negative rule coverage

cases.source_readiness: archived real build, SBOM, SDK export and negative CTI capture available; reusing the archive is an explicitly recorded replay
remaining_preparation: Use archived source timestamps and instance ID unchanged for a replay, or collect a new coherent build/run
Configure final real profile without replacing unknown digests or IRI with invented values
Keep any new unrelated findings separate from the historical snapshot expectation

cases.name: insufficient_evidence
cases.change_from_baseline: insufficient software identity for CTI; do not simulate a service outage as a domain abstention
cases.source_readiness: existing mock and ambiguous CTI capture available; coherent degraded input for the final run still to materialize
remaining_preparation: Record the exact identity degradation and retain the original source hashes
Use the exact observed label; no hidden alias correction or invention of version/CVE
Declare any modified telemetry copy as controlled synthetic degradation, not a fresh original SDK observation
Missing source files, missing mandatory attributes and timeouts are technical failures, not this expected outcome

cases.name: vulnerable_with_operational_constraint

real_target.selection: first alternative effectiveStatus=accepted if one exists; otherwise preserve the actual prerequisites/review/no-valid outcome
real_target.fallback_proof: only if an earlier ranked candidate was actually not acceptable and a later one selected
real_target.shared_finalization: completed with readback for each assessed CVE

cases.source_readiness: same source readiness as C1; operational variation already executable with mocks
remaining_preparation: Reuse exactly the C1 build, SBOM, OTel window, CTI and ontology snapshot
Change only capabilities in the input and validation profile, keeping them equal
Do not describe missing maintenance as a Tiny-ME incompatibility when the operational policy is the evaluator
